title: Training Support
description: Courses and certifications that support infrastructure, cloud and Microsoft 365 administration objectives.

items.name: AZ-104 Azure Administrator
items.detail: Confirm whether Liontrust can support the exam fee, course enrolment or both.

items.name: MS-102 Microsoft 365 Administrator
items.detail: Confirm whether this is a suitable priority for Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, Entra ID and Graph learning.

items.name: Provider guidance
items.detail: Confirm whether Microsoft Learn, an internal route or a paid provider is preferred.

title: Exposure Support
description: Practical learning through observation, mentoring and smaller supervised tasks.

items.name: Infrastructure exposure
items.detail: Observe planned work, process walkthroughs, maintenance activities and change implementation where appropriate.

items.name: Security exposure
items.detail: Observe security processes, access reviews, investigations or reporting activities where suitable.

items.name: Guided participation
items.detail: Assist with lower-risk tasks, documentation, runbooks, testing and validation under supervision.

title: Tooling and Access
description: Approved tools for scripting, documentation, automation projects and safe proof-of-concept work.

items.name: Development tools
items.detail: VS Code, PowerShell 7, Python, Node.js, Git, Git Bash and Windows Terminal.

items.name: Source control guidance
items.detail: Confirm whether GitHub is acceptable for personal learning projects or whether an internal source control platform should be used.

items.name: Microsoft 365 development tenant
items.detail: Useful for safely testing Graph, Entra ID, Exchange, SharePoint, Teams, Intune and Power Platform concepts away from production.

items.name: Documentation tools
items.detail: Obsidian or Markdown-based documentation workflow for notes, testing records and project write-ups.

title: Lab Resources
description: Safe environments for practical learning without affecting production systems.

items.name: Approved cloud development environments
items.detail: Preferred primary approach where available and appropriate.

items.name: Surplus equipment process
items.detail: Confirm whether decommissioned or surplus equipment can be loaned or reused under an approved process.

items.name: Potential equipment
items.detail: Mini PCs, small desktops, older laptops, RAM, SSDs or HDDs, switches, NICs, monitors and network cables.

title: Automation Discussion
description: Initial ideas to review against team priorities, risk and usefulness.

items.name: Leaver process automation
items.detail: Explore reporting, account disablement, group removal, licence validation and completion checklists where appropriate.

items.name: Starter process automation
items.detail: Explore mailbox monitoring, data extraction, account creation, default group assignment and onboarding checklists.

items.name: Windows deployment automation
items.detail: Explore unattended installation, device naming, partitioning and consistent workstation provisioning.

items.name: Future ideas
items.detail: Health dashboards, Microsoft Graph automation, security reporting, asset improvements, documentation generation and AI-assisted workflows.
